analyst_test: A strong analyst who joins the testing schedule to the payment population, resolves the payment lines to invoices, drops the two credit notes and the re-delivered batch, carries the supplier numbers through the crosswalk and reads every working paper correctly still projects the misstatement by scaling the errors found on the ratio the files make obvious, the population's book value over the tested book value, and files 159,241 euro; with basic precision added that is 699,241 against tolerable misstatement of 1,500,000, so the population is certified. The projection the tested set's own selection entitles is 1,043,412, and its upper misstatement limit of 1,997,810 sends the population to extended testing.

differentiation.task184: the unit there is the event-hour a thing could have happened in; here the unit is sound and what changes is how much of the population one tested unit represents.
differentiation.task185: the method there is selected between conversions of one measuring device, and what the data settles is which conversion applies at the value being converted; here nothing is converted and no device changes. What the data settles is how much of an untested population one tested item represents, recovered from the realised selection itself, and the easy route is a scale-up that is arithmetically sound and demographically wrong.
differentiation.task190_v1: architecture 1 settled whether unobserved members were in the population, which failed the WHAT screen. Here the population is every payment line in the year and is beyond argument; what is open is what a tested line stands for.
differentiation.task190_v2: the slot's own architecture 2 estimated a counterfactual density and the specifications disagreed; here no curve is fitted to anything. The deciding quantity is an exact weighted sum over the tested items once one integer, the selection interval, is recovered, and the interval is pinned three independent ways by the realised set.
differentiation.task195: G16 there selects between two screens on the uncertainty of their paired difference; here the realised selection pattern entitles one projection and no uncertainty argument is needed to reach it.
differentiation.task267: population_selection there is survival behind a join on a diagnostic cohort; here it is the inclusion probability of a designed sample, recovered from the sample rather than filed.
differentiation.task457: that architecture measured a reporting error against what each report could have covered by its own date, which is a maturity problem and is banned on this slot. Here every record is complete and final on the day it is read; nothing arrives late and nothing is unobserved. What is unknown is only the design that chose which complete records were examined.
differentiation.task80: the rule there dates a conferred status from its criterion event rather than from first observation, so the decisive quantity is a date and the correction is a re-dating. Here there is no status and no dating: the decisive quantity is a currency amount and the correction is a reweighting of findings by the probability each tested item had of being tested at all.

domain_test: The deciding quantity is the misstatement in a population projected from a sample, which audit estimates on the sample's own inclusion probabilities because the sample was drawn in euro and not in items: every item at or above the sampling interval was certain of selection and stands only for itself, and every item below it was selected with probability proportional to its amount, so a tainting projects at the interval and not at a book-value ratio. Swap the nouns to a utility sampling meter readings for a billing error rate and the design has no reason to exist: a utility samples meters, because what it is testing is meters, so inclusion is equal and the ratio projection is the right one. The proportional design exists only because materiality is denominated in the same unit as the population, which is what makes this an audit sampling problem and not a counting one.
driver: Items were drawn into the tested set with probability proportional to their size, so a tested item stands for a fixed amount of the population rather than for one item, and every item above that amount was certain to be drawn and stands only for itself. The selection amount is stated nowhere and is recovered from the tested set as the only amount for which every tested item contains a step of cumulated value and no untested item does, so scaling the findings on the ratio of total size to tested size understates the population's defect by a multiple, because the large items are all tested and sound while the defects sit in many small items that each stand for a whole step.
driver_concrete: The year's capital payments were tested by monetary-unit selection at an interval no file records, recovered uniquely from the tested set: 180,000 euro is the only interval on which all 273 tested lines contain a step of cumulated value and none of the 24,400 untested lines does. Projecting each tainting at that interval, with the certainty lines at their own error, gives 1,043,412 euro; scaling the errors found on book value gives 159,241 and certifies the population against tolerable misstatement of 1,500,000.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the stock of undetected cases a scarce reviewer would meet, which is each unit's arrival rate multiplied by how long a case goes unseen there, so ranking units by the cases they confirm ranks them by arrivals alone and passes over the unit whose cases sit longest before anyone sees them.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 on 2026-10-17 after three consecutive determinism SEND_BACK verdicts (r2 the working-day calendar, r3 the counting convention, r4 three ask conventions), with Gate F graded moderate to borderline then moderate to low. The decisive step was deciding to nowcast the caseload rather than count it, which settles whether members not yet observed are in the population: filing it made the computation follow from clause 6.2 and not filing it left the call open. Three isolated readers built the nowcast and landed the call at 80 to 90 per cent confidence. Re-rooted, not resumed; the stock-from-arrivals-and-time-unseen driver is not reused.
lineage.stump: A competent solver conforms the alert and adjudication extracts, computes each line's confirmed cases per 1,000 customers over the last two quarters, and assigns the team to the lines that confirm the most, which is the lines where cases are found fastest rather than where they are sitting unfound.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many items were placed just under a threshold to stay under it, and the practice that placed them there leaves a matching shortfall just over the threshold, because the item each one replaced is not in the record any more. The surplus below and the shortfall above are the same quantity measured twice off one fitted size profile, so the record's own arithmetic refuses any profile whose two sides disagree, and a profile fitted through the emptied interval reads the surplus too large.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-17 after three passes. Judge pass 1 SEND_BACK: the method was not forced and the data did not separate the candidates (310 to 512 across windows and families). Judge pass 2 SEND_BACK: the convergence was bought by an amount draw too smooth to separate them (chi-square per degree of freedom 0.029 bank-wide, tail probability below 1e-26). Judge pass 3 SEND_BACK, NOT_DETERMINISTIC: the realism was fixed and held (chi-square 1.11 to 1.44, p 0.06 to 0.23, amounts sampled not drawn from a curve) but the golden then reproduced under exactly one estimator, the average of the surplus below and the deficit above, which the pack files nowhere; surplus alone gave 71 to 786 and deficit alone 207 to 858, and the average agreed only because it cancels the fitted profile's level algebraically, being the half difference of two observed counts less a half slope correction. The refusal rule the build used, failing to reconcile within a fifth, is in no shipped file, so the 141 standing specifications cannot be reproduced from the bundle. Three further findings each needed redesign rather than repair: a flat rate on the paid-in column matched 7 of 8 segment cells, so book size alone reproduced the table; summing rounded segments and rounding the unrounded sum agreed in only 93 of 186 specifications; and the half difference's own sampling standard error was 31.7 against a cell 1.6 standard errors wide. Every structural gate passed every time, Gate G and Gate H included. The lesson for the slot: a decisive step that is an estimation choice over a fitted counterfactual density cannot be both forced and silent, because the specifications always disagree and nothing filable chooses between them without becoming rule application.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-17 at stage 4 after two determinism judge passes, the second NOT_DETERMINISTIC SEND_BACK with stump power moderate to low. The bind is a property of the draw and not a tuning problem: the refer rested on basic precision, whose Poisson reliability factor Gate B forced the bundle to carry (a call resting on an input the pack does not hold fails outright), and carrying the factor table with the terms it uses supplied the vocabulary that made the probability-proportional projection recoverable, so Gate F fell. Fixing Gate B broke Gate F and fixing Gate F broke Gate B. The judge's blind enumeration filed the projection and matched the golden on all nine programme figures, the authority figure, the largest programme and the referral; the cold leak reader of the same pack landed the call at 80 to 90 per cent confidence. A landed call banks about 45 before any ask, so the top two could not average under 40 whatever the ask layer did (the measured 38.1 was (56.0 + 20.1) / 2, the 20.1 being a response that misses the call). The lane retires nothing, so the number re-roots at architecture 4; the rule taken from this death is that the decisive step may never rest on a constant or factor table Gate B forces the pack to ship. Nothing is resumed: not the monetary-unit sampling world, not the what-one-tested-item-stands-for driver, not the ladder, not the pack.

niche: internal audit of a port authority's capital programme payments, where the year's testing was drawn by monetary-unit selection and the projected misstatement decides whether the population is certified or goes to extended testing
notes: Architecture 3, drawn 2026-10-17 after the author called architecture 2 spent. Drawn under four constraints written from this slot's own lineage: no quantity whose estimate depends on a fitted counterfactual density; the blind-response test run at the draw on the widest graded component; any convergence claim screened for insensitivity rather than asserted; and no sentence filed at authority without the author's approval. The decisive quantity is determinate by construction: once the selection interval is recovered it is one exact sum, with no window, bin, family or order to choose. G16 is the decisive generator because the realised selection pattern, and nothing filed, entitles the projection; G17 carries the supporting rung (whether the projection survives its own sampling uncertainty against materiality) and G10 the Layer 1 many-to-one from payment lines to invoices. This is the number's third architecture, so if it is spent the number retires. The house domain is Accounting, Audit and Forensic and it is filed against the client's Survey Research and Official Statistics, because the deciding method is design-based estimation from a probability-proportional-to-size sample; the subdomain audit-testing-sampling has never been drawn and accounting-audit-forensic x anomaly-detection is a never-built pairing. WARN repeat.gate_g and overuse.gate_g answered together: method_or_model_selection is the honest Gate G because the realised selection pattern, and nothing filed, entitles one projection; it is used in 7 of the last 12 but every one of those selects between models, back-tests or screens fitted to data, while this one selects between weightings of a complete record, which is why the nearest driver on file scores 0.07. context_artifact is 'other', named here as required: the head of internal audit works from the audit file itself, a working paper pack holding the year's testing schedule as a table inside a PDF with the tested lines, their book amounts and their audited amounts. That is none of the listed types, and the three that were close are each banned against the last three builds (register, close_out_summary, filed_standard), which is how the honest key was reached rather than a dodge. The gate_g WARNs are accepted rather than redrawn because no other key is true of this build: binding_constraint, decomposition_attribution, forecasting and signal_vs_noise would each misdescribe it, statistical_rigor alone is illegal, and the two surface-read keys are rejections. The right place to carry the variety is the driver, which scores 0.07 against the whole corpus, the lowest this slot has drawn. Stage 2 correction, measured before the ladder was fixed and re-measured on the cut pack: the certainty threshold does NOT pin the interval on its own. The largest untested line is 85,087.70 and the smallest certainty line is 180,726.00, so that route gives only the bracket (85,087.70, 180,726.00], which spans 383,447.76 to 814,441.81 in the figure, a 112 per cent spread. What pins the interval uniquely is the lattice: 180,000 is the only interval on a one-euro grid over 178,000 to 182,000 for which every tested line contains a step of cumulated recorded value under one common start and no untested line does, which the 271 tested and 26,377 untested lines constrain. Measured on the cut pack, the tested lines alone already pin both the interval and a 23.76-euro start window, so the untested side confirms the recovery rather than carrying it. The certainty threshold is a check on it, not an independent pin.
